record_scope: one record for each of the 12 test colonies

required_fields.colony_id: exactly one canonical test-colony ID C01 through C12; unique
required_fields.source_nest_id: nonempty immutable source-nest identifier; all 12 test colonies must have distinct source_nest_id values because fragments from one source nest count as one colony
required_fields.first_trial_timestamp_local: ISO-8601 local timestamp with offset; must match the earliest trial_start_timestamp for this colony
required_fields.lab_acclimation_days_before_first_trial: derived number >= 7 from lab_acclimation_start_timestamp_local to first_trial_timestamp_local
required_fields.food_deprivation_hours_before_first_tria: derived number in [94,98] from food_deprivation_start_timestamp_local to first_trial_timestamp_local
required_fields.test_date_local: YYYY-MM-DD equal to the local date of all 40 trial_start_timestamp values for this colony
required_fields.test_day_lights_on_timestamp_local: ISO-8601 local timestamp with offset on test_date_local
required_fields.all_trials_within_2_to_10_hours_after_li: boolean true and mechanically verified against all 40 trial_start_timestamp values
required_fields.husbandry_or_environment_deviation: null or text; any deviation preserved

validation_rules: exactly 12 colony records are required, one each for C01 through C12
all wild_source_colony_id values must identify distinct wild-source colonies
all source_nest_id values must be distinct across the 12 test colonies; fragments from the same source nest cannot be counted as separate colonies
lab_acclimation_days_before_first_trial must be at least 7 days
pre-deprivation feeding must be 0.5 M sucrose ad libitum plus chopped cockroach protein three times per week
food_deprivation_hours_before_first_trial must be 96 plus or minus 2 hours with water ad libitum
all 40 trials for a colony must share test_date_local and each trial_start_timestamp must fall 2 through 10 hours after test_day_lights_on_timestamp_local
session room temperature and relative humidity remain recorded per trial/session under the trial schema
no food reward may be present in the test maze
no environmental or husbandry protocol change is permitted after collection starts

activation validates only the prospective setup fields that can truthfully exist before trial 1; first-trial time, observed test date, observed lights-on relation, and derived durations are validated during collection and final dataset qualification
activation_rule: Before the first biological trial, all 12 records must exist with every activation_required_prospective_fields value complete and valid, including distinct source nests. Fields in collection_observed_or_derived_fields must not be prefilled from future observations; they are recorded or derived prospectively as each colony is tested.
